item.title: Sengoku no Kuroyuri ~Futanari Hime to Tekikoku no Himegimi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kotoba Asobi
  • 発売日: 2012-08-11
  • スコア: 7.58/10 (59 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 戦国の黒百合 ～ふたなり姫と敵国の姫君～
  • 英語名: Sengoku no Kuroyuri Futanari Hime to Tekikoku no Himegimi

别名

  • Sengoku Black Yuri -Futanari Princess and the Enemy Princess-

あらすじ

Continuing from the previous instalment, Princess Oda Saku of Owari Province continues her struggle to take control of her own future in a time where women are afforded little to no political power. Amidst the political intrigue, plots, and betrayal, another princess is added to the mix as Owari formally receives and welcomes a noble lady from an enemy nation for diplomatic reasons.

item.title: Sengoku no Kuroyuri ~Futanari Hime to Reizoku no Shoujo~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kotoba Asobi
  • 発売日: 2010-12-31
  • スコア: 7.1/10 (79 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 戦国の黒百合～ふたなり姫と隷属の少女～
  • 英語名: Sengoku no Kuroyuri Futanari Hime to Reizoku no Shoujo

别名

  • Sengoku Black Yuri -Futanari Princess and the Vassal Girl-

あらすじ

Set in the Sengoku period – a time characterised by warring factions and constant social upheaval – the story is centred around Oda Nobunaga’s sister, Saku. As the princess to Owari Province, she is arranged to be married off politically by her brother to Oumi, in order to solidify the two provinces’ ties.
